svg.text: Predictor: the branch's Taylor series in D, built order by order and summed at the step
left: a toy branch (1 + h/R)^(−1/2) and its partial sums (an illustration) · right: the chain's terms |z_k| aᵏ (largest over the 769 unknowns) at two bases
step h in units of the radius R
the nearest singularity is at h = −R, behind the base

g.text: ε |z₁| a, the step rule’s bound (ε = 10⁻⁵)
the base: a converged state at D₀
order by order: J(z₀) z_k = −r_k, r_k from the quad-double jet of z₀ + z₁h + … + z_(k−1)h^(k−1)
the step: a_max where the last term |z_N| a^N falls to ε |z₁| a, then a = min(a_max, h_max)
the prediction Σ z_k aᵏ, summed by Horner in quad-double, goes to the re-seed
